function numpy_seed(f, seed, addl_seeds...)
    if seed === nothing
        f()
        return
    end
    if length(addl_seeds) > 0
        seed = Int(hash((seed, addl_seeds...)) % 1e6)
    end
    state = Random.default_rng()
    Random.seed!(seed)
    try
        f()
    finally
        Random.seed!(state)
    end
end

function floyd_warshall(M)
    nrows, ncols = size(M)
    @assert nrows == ncols
    n = nrows
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] == 0
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        M[i, i] = 0
    end
    for k in 1:n
        for i in 1:n
            for j in 1:n
                cost_ikkj = M[i, k] + M[k, j]
                if M[i, j] > cost_ikkj
                    M[i, j] = cost_ikkj
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] >= 510
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    return M
end

function getindex(dataset::ShortestPathDataset, idx)
    data = dataset.dataset[idx]
    num_atoms = size(data["atoms"], 1)
    offset = 0
    if dataset.has_bos
        num_atoms += 1
        offset = 1
    end
    if dataset.has_eos
        num_atoms += 1
    end
    adj = fill(510, num_atoms, num_atoms)
    edge_index = data["edge_index"]
    adj[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset] .= 1
    shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(adj)
    shortest_path_result[shortest_path_result .> 510] .= 510
    spatial_pos = Int.(shortest_path_result)
    return spatial_pos
end

function collate_1d_features(values, pad_idx; pad_to_multiple=1)
    v = values[1]
    size_max = maximum(size(v, 1) for v in values)
    if pad_to_multiple != 1 && size_max % pad_to_multiple != 0
        size_max = Int(floor((size_max - 0.1) / pad_to_multiple + 1) * pad_to_multiple)
    end
    res = fill(pad_idx, length(values), size_max, size(v)[end])
    for (i, v) in enumerate(values)
        res[i, 1:size(v, 1), :] = v
    end
    return res

function getindex(dataset::AtomFeatDataset, idx)
    data = dataset.dataset[idx]
    if dataset.remove_hydrogen
        num_atoms = length(data["atoms_token"])
    else

    end
    offset = 0
    if dataset.has_bos
        num_atoms += 1
        offset = 1
    end
    if dataset.has_eos
        num_atoms += 1
    end
    feat = fill(1, num_atoms, dataset.num_features)
    if !data["drop_feat"]
        node_attr = data["node_attr"]
        feat[offset+1:offset+size(node_attr, 1), :] = node_attr[:, 2:end] .+ 3
    else
        node_attr = data["node_attr"]
        feat[offset+1:offset+size(node_attr, 1), :] .= 2
    end
    for i in 1:dataset.num_features
        feat[:, i] .+= (i - 1) * dataset.num_vals
    end
    return Int.(feat)

function getindex(dataset::BondDataset, idx)
    data = dataset.dataset[idx]
    if dataset.remove_hydrogen
        num_atoms = length(data["atoms_token"])
    else

    end
    offset = 0
    if dataset.has_bos
        num_atoms += 1
        offset = 1
    end
    if dataset.has_eos
        num_atoms += 1
    end
    edge_feat = fill(1, num_atoms, num_atoms, dataset.num_features)
    if !data["drop_feat"]
        edge_index = data["edge_index"]
        edge_attr = data["edge_attr"]
        edge_feat[:, :, 1] .= 3
        for i in 1:num_atoms
            edge_feat[i, i, 1] = 4
        end
        edge_feat[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset, 1] .= 5
        edge_feat[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset, 2:end] = edge_attr .+ 3
    else
        edge_index = data["edge_index"]
        edge_attr = data["edge_attr"]
        edge_feat[edge_index[1, :] .+ offset, edge_index[2, :] .+ offset, :] .= 2
    end
    for i in 1:dataset.num_features
        edge_feat[:, :, i] .+= dataset.num_vals * (i - 1)
    end
    return Int.(edge_feat)
end

function collater(dataset::BondDataset, samples)
    return collate_2d_features(samples, 0, pad_to_multiple=8)
end

function convert_to_single_emb(x, sizes)
    @assert size(x)[end] == length(sizes)
    offset = 1
    for i in 1:length(sizes)
        @assert all(x[..., i] .< sizes[i])
        x[..., i] = x[..., i] .+ offset
        offset += sizes[i]
    end
    return x
end

mutable struct LMDBDataset

function LMDBDataset(db_dir, split, epoch, max_epoch; lmdb_copy_thread=nothing, tmp_data_dir="/temp/")
    if !isdir(tmp_data_dir)
        mkpath(tmp_data_dir)
    end
    obj = new()
    obj.db_dir = db_dir
    obj.tmp_data_dir = tmp_data_dir
    obj.lmdb_copy_thread = lmdb_copy_thread
    obj.split = split
    obj.max_epoch = max_epoch
    obj.content = load_data(obj, tmp_data_dir, epoch, split)
    return obj
end

function load_data(dataset::LMDBDataset, data_dir, epoch, split)
    dataset.db_path_tgt = joinpath(data_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb")
    dataset.db_path_tgt_lock = joinpath(data_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb.lock")
    if !isfile(dataset.db_path_tgt)
        db_path_src = joinpath(dataset.db_dir, "$(split)_part_$(epoch-1).lmdb")
        if !isfile(db_path_src)
            error("$(db_path_src) not found")
        end
        touch(dataset.db_path_tgt_lock)
        cp(db_path_src, dataset.db_path_tgt)
        rm(dataset.db_path_tgt_lock)
    else
        while isfile(dataset.db_path_tgt_lock)
            sleep(1)
        end
    end
    content = []
    return content
end

function length(dataset::LMDBDataset)
    return length(dataset._keys)
end

function set_epoch(dataset::LMDBDataset, epoch)
    if epoch !== nothing && epoch < dataset.max_epoch
        dataset.content = load_data(dataset, dataset.tmp_data_dir, epoch, dataset.split)
    end
end

    "possible_chirality_list" => ["CHI_UNSPECIFIED", "CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW", "CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW", "CHI_TRIGONALBIPYRAMIDAL", "CHI_OCTAHEDRAL", "CHI_SQUAREPLANAR", "CHI_OTHER"],

    "possible_is_aromatic_list" => [false, true],
    "possible_is_in_ring_list" => [false, true],
    "possible_bond_type_list" => ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "AROMATIC", "misc"],
    "possible_bond_stereo_list" => ["STEREONONE", "STEREOZ", "STEREOE", "STEREOCIS", "STEREOTRANS", "STEREOANY"],

)

function safe_index(l, e)
    try
        return findfirst(isequal(e), l)
    catch
        return length(l)
    end
end

function atom_to_feature_vector(atom)
    atom_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_atomic_num_list"], GetAtomicNum(atom)),
        findfirst(isequal(string(GetChiralTag(atom))), allowable_features["possible_chirality_list"]),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_degree_list"], GetTotalDegree(atom)),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_formal_charge_list"], GetFormalCharge(atom)),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_numH_list"], GetTotalNumHs(atom)),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_number_radical_e_list"], GetNumRadicalElectrons(atom)),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_hybridization_list"], string(GetHybridization(atom))),
        findfirst(isequal(GetIsAromatic(atom)), allowable_features["possible_is_aromatic_list"]),
        findfirst(isequal(IsInRing(atom)), allowable_features["possible_is_in_ring_list"])
    ]
    return atom_feature
end

function bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
    bond_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_bond_type_list"], string(GetBondType(bond))),
        findfirst(isequal(string(GetStereo(bond))), allowable_features["possible_bond_stereo_list"]),
        findfirst(isequal(GetIsConjugated(bond)), allowable_features["possible_is_conjugated_list"])
    ]
    return bond_feature
end

function get_graph(mol)
    atom_features_list = []
    for atom in GetAtoms(mol)
        push!(atom_features_list, atom_to_feature_vector(atom))
    end
    x = hcat(atom_features_list...)'
    num_bond_features = 3
    if length(GetBonds(mol)) > 0
        edges_list = []
        edge_features_list = []
        for bond in GetBonds(mol)
            i = GetBeginAtomIdx(bond)
            j = GetEndAtomIdx(bond)
            edge_feature = bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
            push!(edges_list, (i, j))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
            push!(edges_list, (j, i))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
        end
        edge_index = hcat([[e[1], e[2]] for e in edges_list]...)
        edge_attr = hcat(edge_features_list...)'
    else
        edge_index = zeros(Int, 2, 0)
        edge_attr = zeros(Int, 0, num_bond_features)
    end
    return x, edge_index, edge_attr
end

function get_graph_features(edge_attr, edge_index, x)
    atom_feat_sizes = vcat([128], fill(16, 8))
    edge_feat_sizes = [16, 16, 16]
    N = size(x, 1)
    atom_feat = convert_to_single_emb(x, atom_feat_sizes)
    adj = zeros(Int, N, N)
    adj[edge_index[1, :], edge_index[2, :]] .= 1
    degree = sum(adj, dims=2)[:]
    if ndims(edge_attr) == 1
        edge_attr = reshape(edge_attr, :, 1)
    end
    edge_feat = zeros(Int, N, N, size(edge_attr, 2))
    edge_feat[edge_index[1, :], edge_index[2, :], :] = convert_to_single_emb(edge_attr, edge_feat_sizes) .+ 1
    shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(adj)
    spatial_pos = Int.(shortest_path_result) .+ 1
    feat = Dict()
    feat["atom_feat"] = Int.(atom_feat)
    feat["atom_mask"] = ones(Int, N)
    feat["edge_feat"] = Int.(edge_feat) .+ 1
    feat["shortest_path"] = spatial_pos
    feat["degree"] = Int.(degree) .+ 1
    atoms = feat["atom_feat"][:, 1]
    pair_type = cat(
        repeat(reshape(atoms, :, 1, 1), 1, N, 1),
        repeat(reshape(atoms, 1, :, 1), N, 1, 1),
        dims=3
    )
    feat["pair_type"] = convert_to_single_emb(pair_type, [128, 128])
    feat["attn_bias"] = zeros(Float32, N + 1, N + 1)
    return feat
end

function smi2_graph_features(smiles_string)
    mol = MolFromSmiles(smiles_string)
    mol = AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
    atoms = [GetSymbol(atom) for atom in GetAtoms(mol) if GetSymbol(atom) != "H"]
    mol = RemoveHs(mol)
    x, edge_index, edge_attr = get_graph(mol)
    feat = get_graph_features(edge_attr, edge_index, x)
    feat["atoms_token"] = atoms
    return feat
end

function set_epoch(dataset::MoleculeFeatureDataset, epoch; unused...)

function __cached_item__(dataset::MoleculeFeatureDataset, idx, epoch)
    data = dataset.dataset[idx]
    mol = MolFromSmiles(data[dataset.smi_key])
    mol = AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
    atoms_h = [GetSymbol(atom) for atom in GetAtoms(mol)]

    @assert 0.0 < mask_prob <= 1.0
    @assert 0.0 < mask_token_prob < 1.0
    @assert 0.0 <= random_token_prob <= 1.0
    @assert 0.0 <= leave_unmasked_prob <= 1.0
    @assert random_token_prob + leave_unmasked_prob <= 1.0

    obj.random_token_prob = random_token_prob
    obj.has_bos = has_bos
    obj.has_eos = has_eos

    end

    if noise_type == "trunc_normal"

    elseif noise_type == "normal"

function __getitem_cached__(dataset::NoisePointsDataset, epoch, index)
    ret = Dict()
    Random.seed!(hash((dataset.seed, epoch, index)))
    item = dataset.dataset[index]
    coord = dataset.coord_dataset[index]
    sz = length(item)
    @assert sz > 0
    num_mask_token = Int(floor(dataset.mask_token_prob * sz + rand()))
    mask_idc = shuffle(1:sz)[1:num_mask_token]
    mask_token = fill(false, sz)
    mask_token[mask_idc] .= true
    ret["targets"] = fill(dataset.pad_idx, length(mask_token))
    ret["targets"][mask_token] = item[mask_token]
    rand_or_unmask_prob = dataset.random_token_prob + dataset.leave_unmasked_prob
    if rand_or_unmask_prob > 0.0
        rand_or_unmask = mask_token .&& (rand(sz) .< rand_or_unmask_prob)
        if dataset.random_token_prob == 0.0
            unmask = rand_or_unmask
            rand_mask = nothing
        elseif dataset.leave_unmasked_prob == 0.0
            unmask = nothing
            rand_mask = rand_or_unmask
        else
            unmask_prob = dataset.leave_unmasked_prob / rand_or_unmask_prob
            decision = rand(sz) .< unmask_prob
            unmask = rand_or_unmask .&& decision
            rand_mask = rand_or_unmask .&& (.!decision)
        end
    else
        unmask = nothing
        rand_mask = nothing
    end
    if unmask !== nothing
        mask_token = mask_token .⊻ unmask
    end
    new_item = copy(item)
    new_item[mask_token] .= dataset.mask_idx
    if rand_mask !== nothing
        num_rand = sum(rand_mask)
        if num_rand > 0
            new_item[rand_mask] = rand(1:length(dataset.vocab), num_rand)
        end
    end
    ret["atoms"] = Int.(new_item)
    num_mask = Int(floor(dataset.mask_prob * sz + rand()))
    mask_idc = shuffle(1:sz)[1:num_mask]
    mask = fill(false, sz)
    mask[mask_idc] .= true
    ret["mask_cord"] = mask
    new_coord = copy(coord)
    new_coord[mask, :] .+= dataset.noise_f(num_mask)
    ret["coordinates"] = Float32.(new_coord)
    if dataset.has_bos
        sz += 1
    end
    if dataset.has_eos
        sz += 1
    end
    ret["attn_bias"] = zeros(Float32, sz, sz)
    return ret
end

function get_graph_features_unimol2(edge_attr, edge_index, node_attr, drop_feat)
    atom_feat_sizes = fill(16, 8)
    edge_feat_sizes = [16, 16, 16]
    N = size(node_attr, 1)
    atom_feat = convert_to_single_emb(node_attr[:, 2:end], atom_feat_sizes)
    adj = zeros(Int, N, N)
    adj[edge_index[1, :], edge_index[2, :]] .= 1
    degree = sum(adj, dims=2)[:]
    if ndims(edge_attr) == 1
        edge_attr = reshape(edge_attr, :, 1)
    end
    edge_feat = zeros(Int, N, N, size(edge_attr, 2))
    edge_feat[edge_index[1, :], edge_index[2, :], :] = convert_to_single_emb(edge_attr, edge_feat_sizes) .+ 1
    shortest_path_result = floyd_warshall(copy(adj))
    if drop_feat
        atom_feat .= 1
        edge_feat .= 1
        degree .= 1
        shortest_path_result .= 511
    else
        atom_feat .+= 2
        edge_feat .+= 2
        degree .+= 2
        shortest_path_result .+= 1
    end
    feat = Dict()
    feat["atom_feat"] = Int.(atom_feat)
    feat["atom_mask"] = ones(Int, N)
    feat["edge_feat"] = Int.(edge_feat)
    feat["shortest_path"] = Int.(shortest_path_result)
    feat["degree"] = Int.(degree)
    atoms = feat["atom_feat"][:, 1]
    pair_type = cat(
        repeat(reshape(atoms, :, 1, 1), 1, N, 1),
        repeat(reshape(atoms, 1, :, 1), N, 1, 1),
        dims=3
    )
    feat["pair_type"] = convert_to_single_emb(pair_type, [128, 128])
    feat["attn_bias"] = zeros(Float32, N + 1, N + 1)
    return feat
end

function kabsch_rotation(P, Q)
    C = P' * Q
    U, S, V = svd(C)
    d = det(U) * det(V) < 0.0
    if d
        U[:, end] = -U[:, end]
    end
    R = U * V'
    return R
end

function get_optimal_transform(src_atoms, tgt_atoms)
    src_center = mean(src_atoms, dims=1)
    tgt_center = mean(tgt_atoms, dims=1)
    r = kabsch_rotation(src_atoms .- src_center, tgt_atoms .- tgt_center)
    x = tgt_center .- src_center * r
    return r, x
end

function __getitem_cached__(dataset::Unimol2FeatureDataset, epoch, idx)
    ret = Dict()
    Random.seed!(hash((dataset.seed, epoch, idx)))
    src_token = dataset.token_dataset[idx]
    src_token_mask, target_token = get_masked_token(dataset, src_token, dataset.mask_token_prob)

        molecule_feat["edge_attr"],

        molecule_feat["node_attr"],

    if !molecule_feat["drop_feat"]
        if rand() < dataset.use_2d_pos
            src_pos = dataset.src_2d_pos_dataset[idx]
            tgt_pos = src_pos
        else
            src_pos = dataset.src_pos_dataset[idx]

        tgt_pos = src_pos

    ret["src_pos"] = Float32.(masked_pos)

    ret["src_mask_cord"] = mask_coord_index
    merge!(ret, feat)
    return ret
end

function Linear(in_features, out_features; bias=true, init="default")
    weight = randn(Float32, out_features, in_features)
    bias_vec = bias ? zeros(Float32, out_features) : nothing
    if init == "glorot"
        weight .*= sqrt(2.0 / (in_features + out_features))
    elseif init == "relu"
        weight .*= sqrt(2.0 / in_features)
    elseif init == "final"
        weight .*= 0.02
    elseif init == "gating"
        weight .= 0
        if bias
            bias_vec .= 1
        end
    end
    return new(weight, bias_vec, in_features, out_features)
end

function Attention(q_dim, k_dim, v_dim, pair_dim, head_dim, num_heads; gating=false, dropout=0.0)
    total_dim = head_dim * num_heads
    linear_g = gating ? Linear(q_dim, total_dim, init="gating") : nothing
    return new(
        num_heads,
        gating,
        Linear(q_dim, total_dim, bias=false, init="glorot"),
        Linear(k_dim, total_dim, bias=false, init="glorot"),
        Linear(v_dim, total_dim, bias=false, init="glorot"),
        Linear(total_dim, q_dim, init="final"),
        linear_g,
        head_dim^(-0.5),
        dropout,
        Linear(pair_dim, num_heads)
    )
end

function forward(attn::Attention, q, k, v, pair; mask=nothing)
    g = nothing
    if attn.linear_g !== nothing
        g = forward(attn.linear_g, q)
    end
    q = forward(attn.linear_q, q)
    q .*= attn.norm
    k = forward(attn.linear_k, k)
    v = forward(attn.linear_v, v)
    q = permutedims(reshape(q, size(q)[1:end-1]..., attn.num_heads, :), [1, ndims(q), ndims(q)-1, 2:ndims(q)-2...])
    k = permutedims(reshape(k, size(k)[1:end-1]..., attn.num_heads, :), [1, ndims(k), ndims(k)-1, 2:ndims(k)-2...])
    v = permutedims(reshape(v, size(v)[1:end-1]..., attn.num_heads, :), [1, ndims(v), ndims(v)-1, 2:ndims(v)-2...])
    attn_scores = batched_mul(q, permutedims(k, [1, 2, 4, 3]))
    bias = permutedims(forward(attn.linear_bias, pair), [1, 4, 2, 3])
    attn_scores = softmax_dropout(attn_scores, attn.dropout, training, mask=mask, bias=bias)
    o = batched_mul(attn_scores, v)
    o = permutedims(o, [1, ndims(o)-1, 3:ndims(o)-2..., 2, ndims(o)])
    o = reshape(o, size(o)[1:end-2]..., :)
    if g !== nothing
        o = sigmoid.(g) .* o
    end
    o = forward(attn.linear_o, o)
    return o
end

    return new(

        Linear(d_hid^2, d_pair),

function _opm(op::OuterProduct, a, b)
    bsz, n, d = size(a)
    a = reshape(a, bsz, n, 1, d, 1)
    b = reshape(b, bsz, 1, n, 1, d)
    outer = a .* b
    outer = reshape(outer, size(outer)[1:end-2]..., :)
    outer = forward(op.linear_out, outer)
    return outer
end

function apply_memory_efficient(op::OuterProduct)
    op._memory_efficient = true
end

function forward(op::OuterProduct, m; op_mask=nothing, op_norm=nothing)
    ab = forward(op.linear_in, m)
    if op_mask !== nothing
        ab = ab .* op_mask
    end
    a, b = chunk(ab, 2, dims=ndims(ab))
    if op._memory_efficient && training
        z = checkpoint(_opm, op, a, b)
    else
        z = _opm(op, a, b)
    end
    if op_norm !== nothing
        z .*= op_norm
    end
    return z
end

function gelu(x)

function softmax_dropout(x, dropout, training; mask=nothing, bias=nothing)
    if mask !== nothing
        x = x .+ mask
    end
    if bias !== nothing
        x = x .+ bias
    end
    x = softmax(x, dims=ndims(x))
    if training && dropout > 0

function nll_loss(lprobs, targets; reduction="mean")
    loss = -lprobs[CartesianIndex.(1:length(targets), targets)]
    if reduction == "sum"
        return sum(loss)
    elseif reduction == "mean"
        return mean(loss)

function mse_loss(pred, target; reduction="mean")
    loss = (pred .- target).^2
    if reduction == "sum"
        return sum(loss)
    elseif reduction == "mean"
        return mean(loss)
    else

function mae_loss(pred, target; reduction="mean")
    loss = abs.(pred .- target)
    if reduction == "sum"
        return sum(loss)
    elseif reduction == "mean"
        return mean(loss)
    else
        return loss
    end
end

function smooth_l1_loss(pred, target; reduction="mean", beta=1.0)
    diff = abs.(pred .- target)
    loss = ifelse.(diff .< beta, 0.5 .* diff.^2 ./ beta, diff .- 0.5 .* beta)
    if reduction == "sum"
        return sum(loss)
    elseif reduction == "mean"
        return mean(loss)
    else
        return loss
    end

function binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pred, target; reduction="mean")
    max_val = clamp.(-pred, 0, Inf)
    loss = pred .- pred .* target .+ max_val .+ log.(exp.(-max_val) .+ exp.(-pred .- max_val))
    if reduction == "sum"
        return sum(loss)
    elseif reduction == "mean"
        return mean(loss)
    else
        return loss
    end
end

function chunk(x, n; dims=1)
    size_dim = size(x, dims)
    chunk_size = div(size_dim, n)
    indices = [selectdim(x, dims, (i-1)*chunk_size+1:i*chunk_size) for i in 1:n]
    return indices
end

function batched_mul(a, b)

function batched_matrix_mul(a, b)
    if ndims(a) == 4 && ndims(b) == 4
        result = similar(a, size(a, 1), size(a, 2), size(a, 3), size(b, 4))
        for i in 1:size(a, 1)
            for j in 1:size(a, 2)
                result[i, j, :, :] = a[i, j, :, :] * b[i, j, :, :]
            end
        end
        return result
    else
        return a * b
    end
end
